DIV8.HEAD: § 1010.999 Test section for parser fixtures.
DIV8.P: (a) In general. Each covered institution must establish written procedures for widget identification.
(b) Identification and verification. With respect to widgets the institution must:
(1) Identify each widget owner by obtaining the required information at the time of opening.
(2) Verify the identity of each widget owner within a reasonable time, according to risk.
(i) For documentary verification, an unexpired government-issued document is required.
(ii) For non-documentary verification, independent data sources may be used instead.
(c) Definitions. For purposes of this section the following terms apply as stated below.
(d) Recordkeeping. Records made under this section shall include all of the following items.
(e) Retention. Records shall be retained for five years after the account is closed.
(f) Reliance. Reliance on another institution is permitted when reasonable and documented.
(g) Exclusions. Certain entities are excluded from the widget ownership requirement entirely.
(h) Exemptions. The following accounts are exempt from the requirements of paragraph (b).
(i) Special measures. Nothing in this section relieves an institution of other obligations.
This undesignated paragraph continues the discussion of special measures without a marker.
(j) Effective date. Compliance with this section is required as of the applicability date.
